test_support_condition.claim: H^k(P|_S) = 0 for k > -dim(S) for each stratum

test_ic_quad_cone_odd.claim: IC(quadric_cone) has H^k = 0 for k odd (rationally smooth)

test_simple_ic_direct_sum.claim: Simple perverse sheaves decompose as ⊕ IC(Z_i, L_i)

test_support_violation_unsat.claim: Support condition for dim(S)=1 violated: H^2 nonzero when it must be 0

test_tstruct_violation_unsat.claim: t-structure orthogonality violated: Hom(A, B[1]) claimed nonzero

test_non_semisimple_extension.claim: Non-split extension violates semi-simplicity of perverse sheaves

test_boundary_constant_sheaf.claim: Constant sheaf ℚ_X is a (trivial) perverse sheaf

test_boundary_smooth_ic.claim: For smooth X, IC(X) = ℚ_X (constant sheaf)

test_boundary_ic_stability.claim: IC structure stable under small deformations of singularities
